arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Saharia argued TPS recipients meet the admission requirement. She cited Section 1254a(f)(4).
Mr. Huston argued the agency acted lawfully. He cited the statutory definition of the term.
Justice Breyer questioned the logical interpretation of the statute. He asked for a simple explanation.
Justice Thomas asked for case law support. He questioned the assumption that status implies admission.
